# International Kettlebell and Fitness Federation (IKFF)

> > Official home of IKFF kettlebell certifications, competitions, and training programs led by Steve Cotter and master trainers worldwide.

The International Kettlebell and Fitness Federation offers comprehensive kettlebell training through self-paced online courses, live certifications (CKT Level 1 & 2), specialized workshops including flow juggling, and hosts the annual IKFF World Championship competition. Training is available globally with master trainers in locations including San Diego, Norway, and Albuquerque.

## Key Topics

- IKFF Kettlebell Certification
- Certified Kettlebell Trainer (CKT)
- Level 1 Certification
- Level 2 Certification
- Steve Cotter
- Self-paced online training
- Live certification courses
- Kettlebell flow juggling
- IKFF World Championship
- Master Trainer programs
- Advanced double bell training
- International fitness certification
- Kettlebell competitions

## Certification Programs

- [IKFF Level 1 Kettlebell Certification SELF-PACED Online Course](https://ikff.com/products/ikff-level-1-kettlebell-certification): IKFF Level 1 self-paced online kettlebell certification with Steve Cotter
- [IKFF LIVE Certified Kettlebell Trainer Level 2 Certification - San Diego](https://ikff.com/products/ikff-live-certified-kettlebell-trainer-level-2-certification): IKFF Level 2 live certification in San Diego, advanced double bell training
- [CKT level 1 & 2 in Norway with IKFF Master Trainer, Allan Fallro](https://ikff.com/pages/allan-fallro-ckt): CKT Level 1 & 2 certification in Norway with Master Trainer Allan Fallro

## Competitions & Events

- [IKFF World Competition (In person or virtual) - The Legend Lives On!](https://ikff.com/products/2025-ikff-world-championship): 2025 IKFF World Championship kettlebell competition, in-person or virtual

## Workshops & Specialized Training

- [IKFF LIVE: Intro to KB Flow Juggling Workshop (Albuquerque, NM)](https://ikff.com/products/ikff-live-intro-to-kb-jugglind-workshop): Kettlebell flow juggling workshop in Albuquerque with Daniel Cotter
